name: cf-workbench
//: Build/lint tooling (typescript, eslint, eslint-config-next, tailwind, shadcn, @types/*) is kept in dependencies rather than devDependencies on purpose: the validation/CI install runs with NODE_ENV=production, which makes `npm install` omit devDependencies. Keeping these as runtime dependencies guarantees `npm run lint` and `npm run build` succeed regardless of NODE_ENV. Only the test harnesses (@playwright/test, vitest) stay devDependencies.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
